title: Следующий уровень и подстава с деньгами  (The Next Level and the Money Setup)

scenes.title: Late-Night Coffee and Choosing a T-Shirt
scenes.summary: Max reflects on taking relationships to the next level as Chef Barinov invites Elena Pavlovna for late-night coffee and Kostya and Nastya look for privacy.

scenes.title: The Canceled Flight and Coffee at the Chef's
scenes.summary: As Barinov and Elena Pavlovna head to their cars, a phone call about a canceled flight ruins plans at her apartment, so she suggests going to Barinov's place instead.

scenes.title: The Excuse About Mom and the Ballet
scenes.summary: Too embarrassed to admit he lives with Lyova and Lyova's mother, Chef Barinov tells Elena Pavlovna that his own strict mother lives with him.

scenes.title: Thrills at the Restaurant and a Gift for Sasha
scenes.summary: Kostya and Nastya sneak around the restaurant looking for privacy, while Sasha thanks a bewildered Max for a pair of expensive earrings she found in her locker.

scenes.title: Earrings from Ilya and Max's Promise
scenes.summary: Max confronts Ilya about planting the earrings in Sasha's locker, and rather than admit the truth to Sasha, Max promises to pay Ilya for the jewelry tomorrow.

scenes.title: Making Up with Elena and Senya's Advice
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov smooths things over with Elena Pavlovna after their awkward parting, then complains to Senya and Fedya that he has nowhere private to invite her.

scenes.title: The Office Couch Idea and the Broken Drain
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya suggest that Chef Barinov bring Elena Pavlovna to the leather couch in his office after hours, while Vika catches Kostya and Nastya in the guest restroom.

scenes.title: Ilya's Shadow in Max's Bedroom
scenes.summary: Max tries to sell his belongings to pay Ilya back, and in bed that night he loses his mood when Sasha wears the earrings Ilya bought for her.

scenes.title: A Surprise in the Closed Restaurant
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov brings Elena Pavlovna into the darkened restaurant for a romantic surprise in his office, only to discover Kostya and Nastya on his office couch.

scenes.title: Three Stages of Refusing a Loan
scenes.summary: Max goes around the kitchen asking all the cooks to lend him fifteen thousand rubles to pay Ilya, but everyone finds an excuse to turn him down.

scenes.title: The Idea to Send Mom to the Ballet
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya tease Chef Barinov after his failed evening in the office and give him the idea to send Lyova's mother to the ballet for the night.

scenes.title: Caring for Lyova's Mother
scenes.summary: While Kostya and Nastya hide in the storage room and blame the noise on the kitchen cat, Chef Barinov guilts Lyova into taking his mother out for the evening.

scenes.title: Two Days Off for Lyova and Visiting Nagiyev
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov gives Lyova two days off and sends him to Saint Petersburg with his mother, while Max decides to ask Nagiyev for an advance.

scenes.title: Nagiyev's Refusal and Inviting Elena
scenes.summary: Nagiyev laughs off Max's request for a loan, while Chef Barinov calls Elena Pavlovna to invite her to his apartment now that his mother is at the ballet.

scenes.title: Theft in Nagiyev's Office
scenes.summary: After Ilya slips out of the upstairs corridor, Nagiyev discovers that money has been stolen from his office desk and lines up the entire restaurant staff.

scenes.title: Evidence Against Max
scenes.summary: When the stolen cash is found stuffed inside Max's locker after everyone heard him begging for a loan, Nagiyev orders Vika to call the police before Ilya suggests simply firing him.

scenes.title: Ilya's Confession for Sasha's Sake
scenes.summary: Suddenly Ilya confesses to Nagiyev in front of everyone that he planted the money to get Max fired so Sasha would come back to him.

scenes.title: The Clever Scheme and Breaking Up with Sasha
scenes.summary: Nagiyev drops the matter since the cash was returned, and when Max gloats to Sasha that Ilya staged the whole confession to manipulate her, an offended Sasha dumps Max.

scenes.title: Elena Visits Barinov's Place
scenes.summary: At Lyova's apartment, Chef Barinov tells Elena Pavlovna that the room belongs to his mother and a struggling friend he took in, charming her with his apparent nobility.

scenes.title: Vera Ivanovna's Return
scenes.summary: Lyova and his mother Vera Ivanovna return early after missing their train, exposing Chef Barinov's lie in front of an outraged Elena Pavlovna.

scenes.title: Confession at the Airport and Changes for the Better
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov catches up with Elena Pavlovna to admit he lied because he was afraid she would not like him, while Kostya and Nastya finally enjoy the apartment to themselves.
